extra_config.description: CBR split-scope (soft) with 10 reviewers — one section anchor each + A/B escape hatch.
focus_areas: CL1-CL3: Missing signals, interface inconsistencies, parameter mismatches
CL6-CL7: Table vs MSC consistency, traceability gaps
reviewer_focus:
YOUR ASSIGNED SCOPE: Section 3.1 (overall design structure, top-level signal flow). Run checklist items CL1-CL3 against the top-level structure. Trace each signal back to the requirements text. Always cite the exact signal name (e.g. 'Order') in your evidence. Primary focus: assigned sections. Outside your focus you MAY log clear A/B defects only if you include precise location (section + page/table/msc) and evidence. Do not broaden search outside focus. Within your focus, log defects of any risk (A/B/C); outside your focus, only A/B.
YOUR ASSIGNED SCOPE: Section 3.2.1 (data structures, request/order signals). Run checklist items CL1-CL3 with extra attention to parameter types and missing cancel/reject signals. Always cite the exact signal name (e.g. 'Reject_Order', 'Cancel_Order') in your evidence. Primary focus: assigned sections. Outside your focus you MAY log clear A/B defects only if you include precise location (section + page/table/msc) and evidence. Do not broaden search outside focus. Within your focus, log defects of any risk (A/B/C); outside your focus, only A/B.

Primary focus: assigned sections. Outside your focus you MAY log clear A/B defects only if you include precise location (section + page/table/msc) and evidence. Do not broaden search outside focus. Within your focus, log defects of any risk (A/B/C); outside your focus, only A/B.
